JOIN "atom" T3 ON T1."molecule_id" = T3."molecule_id"
WHERE T1."label" = 'TR151'
  AND LOWER(T3."element") IN ('cl', 'br', 'f', 'i', 'pb', 'te', 'sn')
ORDER BY T3."element" ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT m."label", a."element"
FROM "molecule" m
JOIN "bond" b ON m."molecule_id" = b."molecule_id"
JOIN "atom" a ON m."molecule_id" = a."molecule_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '#'
ORDER BY m."label" ASC NULLS FIRST, a."element" ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT T3."element"
FROM "molecule" T1
JOIN "atom" T3 ON T1."molecule_id" = T3."molecule_id"
WHERE T1."label" = '-'
  AND T3."atom_id" = 'TR004_7'

SELECT T2."element", T1."label"
FROM "molecule" T1
JOIN "atom" T2 ON T1."molecule_id" = T2."molecule_id"
WHERE T1."molecule_id" = 'TR060'

SELECT DISTINCT a."element"
FROM "bond" b
JOIN "connected" c ON b."bond_id" = c."bond_id"
JOIN "atom" a ON c."atom_id" = a."atom_id"
WHERE b."bond_type" = '='

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."member_id") AS "student_count" 
FROM "member" T1
WHERE LOWER(T1."position") LIKE '%president%'

SELECT e."cost" FROM "expense" AS T1 JOIN "budget" AS T2 ON T1."link_to_budget" = T2."budget_id" JOIN "event" AS T3 ON T2."link_to_event" = T3."event_id" WHERE T3."event_name" LIKE '%Posters%' AND T3."event_date" = '2019-09-04'

SELECT b."category", b."amount" 
FROM "budget" AS b
JOIN "event" AS e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"
WHERE e."event_name" LIKE '%January Speaker%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m."member_id") AS member_count
FROM "member" m
JOIN "major" mj ON m."link_to_major" = mj."major_id"
WHERE mj."major_name" LIKE '%Physics Teaching%'

SELECT T1."first_name", T1."last_name"
FROM "member" T1
JOIN "income" T2 ON T1."member_id" = T2."link_to_member"
WHERE T2."amount" > 40
GROUP BY T1."first_name", T1."last_name"

SELECT DISTINCT m."major_name"
FROM "member" T1
JOIN "major" T2 ON T1."link_to_major" = T2."major_id"
WHERE T1."position" LIKE '%Vice President%'

SELECT "z"."city"
FROM "member" AS "t1"
JOIN "zip_code" AS "z" ON "t1"."zip" = "z"."zip_code"
WHERE "t1"."first_name" LIKE '%Garrett%' AND "t1"."last_name" LIKE '%Gerke%'

SELECT T1."last_name"
FROM "member" T1
JOIN "major" T2 ON T1."link_to_major" = T2."major_id"
WHERE T2."major_name" LIKE '%Law and Constitutional Studies%'

SELECT T1."last_name", T3."department", T3."college"
FROM "member" T1
JOIN "major" T3 ON T1."link_to_major" = T3."major_id"
WHERE T3."major_name" LIKE '%Environmental Engineering%'

SELECT T1."first_name", T1."last_name"
FROM "member" T1
JOIN "expense" T2 ON T1."member_id" = T2."link_to_member"
GROUP BY T1."member_id", T1."first_name", T1."last_name"
ORDER BY MAX(T2."cost") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

SELECT T1."event_name"
FROM "event" T1
JOIN "budget" T2 ON T1."event_id" = T2."link_to_event"
WHERE T2."category" = 'Parking'
  AND T2."spent" < (
    SELECT SUM(T3."spent") / COUNT(T3."link_to_event")
    FROM "budget" T3
    WHERE T3."category" = 'Parking'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT z."city", z."state"
FROM "member" AS T1
JOIN "major" AS T2 ON T1."link_to_major" = T2."major_id"
JOIN "zip_code" AS T3 ON T1."zip" = T3."zip_code"
WHERE T2."department" LIKE '%Electrical and Computer Engineering%'
  AND T1."position" = 'Member'
ORDER BY z."city" ASC NULLS FIRST, z."state" ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT DISTINCT T1."last_name"
FROM "member" T1
JOIN "attendance" T2 ON T1."member_id" = T2."link_to_member"
JOIN "event" T3 ON T2."link_to_event" = T3."event_id"
WHERE T1."position" = 'Member'
  AND T3."event_name" LIKE '%Women%s Soccer%'
ORDER BY T1."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT AVG(T3."cost") AS average_cost
FROM "member" T1
JOIN "expense" T3 ON T1."member_id" = T3."link_to_member"
WHERE T1."first_name" LIKE '%Elijah%'
  AND T1."last_name" LIKE '%Allen%'
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM T3."expense_date") IN (9, 10)

SELECT DISTINCT e."event_name"
FROM "member" AS T1
JOIN "attendance" AS T2 ON T1."member_id" = T2."link_to_member"
JOIN "event" AS T3 ON T2."link_to_event" = T3."event_id"
WHERE T1."position" LIKE '%Vice President%'
  AND T1."link_to_major" IS NOT NULL
  AND T3."type" = 'Social'
  AND T3."location" LIKE '%900 E. Washington St.%'

SELECT DISTINCT m."first_name", m."last_name", a."link_to_event"
FROM "member" m
JOIN "expense" e ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE e."approved" = 'true'
  AND e."expense_date" BETWEEN TO_DATE('2019-01-10', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2019-11-19', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT T1."event_name", T1."event_date"
FROM "event" T1
JOIN "expense" T2 ON T1."event_id" = T2."link_to_event"
WHERE T2."expense_description" = 'Pizza'
  AND T2."cost" > 50
  AND T2."cost" < 100

SELECT T1."first_name", T1."last_name", T1."phone"
FROM "member" T1
JOIN "expense" T2 ON T1."member_id" = T2."link_to_member"
WHERE T2."cost" > (SELECT AVG(T3."cost") FROM "expense" T3)
